# tasknotes-rc5-binding

Collection metadata (`mdbase.yaml`, `_types`, `_contracts`, `_schemas`) copied
unchanged from TaskNotes `tests/fixtures/mdbase-upgrades/meaning-folders`
(tasknotes commit 7a81df512): a real collection written by TaskNotes
5.0.0-beta.5 whose task type implements `tasknotes.task` 0.3.0-rc.5. In that
binding version `archive` still carries `move_on_archive` and `folder`, which
rc.6 moved to the `_settings/dev.tasknotes.md` record. Task notes are omitted;
tests add their own.
